main.description: Record a review action on a resource-flow anomaly. Three actions: acknowledge (operator saw it, accepts as expected), dismiss (false positive, suppress), escalate (route to a downstream investigation channel). Writes vertex_resource_flow_anomaly_review (append-only) and emits a thread reply to the original anomaly post when post_uri is known. Caller must hold a Service Auth JWT with lxm=com.etzhayyim.apps.resourceFlow.reviewAnomaly.

anomalyId.description: vertex_id of the anomaly row (== anomaly_id)

post.description: Emit a thread reply on the anomaly's post_uri.

errors.name: AnomalyNotFound
errors.description: anomalyId does not match any vertex_resource_flow_anomaly row

errors.name: InvalidAction
errors.description: action must be acknowledge / dismiss / escalate
